# Copilot Instructions

- **Framework topology**: Astro app with mixed server/SSR routes in `src/pages/**` and React islands (`client:load`) under `src/components/**`. Docs live in `src/content/**` (Starlight). 3D is built with `@react-three/fiber` + `@react-three/drei` + `three` (see `src/components/title/SpaceScene.tsx`).
- **Auth direction (current branch)**: Title flow is now client-only. Keep key generation via `src/lib/keyManager.ts` (IndexedDB + Web Crypto P-256, non-extractable); do not call `/api/challenge` or `/api/authenticate`. The old server helpers live in `src/mod/**` and `src/pages/api/**` but are being bypassed for this flow. Avoid adding session checks in layouts for title/character-select.
- **Layouts**: General pages use `src/layouts/Layout.astro`. The previous `AuthenticatedLayout.astro` enforced server sessions; `character-select.astro` now uses plain `Layout` to stay client-only.
- **Title screen pattern**: `src/pages/title.astro` renders a full-viewport, scroll-locked experience. Background is the `SpaceScene` canvas (class `space-scene-full`) fixed behind UI; overlay UI is absolutely centered with glassmorphism. Keep UI elements positioned via absolute/relative layers instead of stacking content that adds scroll. Start button is enabled after local key prep.
- **3D scene notes**: `SpaceScene.tsx` uses memoized star buffers, animated earth/moon meshes, fog/background color, and OrbitControls with zoom/pan disabled. Canvas must fill parent; ensure parent has explicit width/height (100vw/100vh) and `overflow:hidden`.
- **State & stores**: Global character selection uses Zustand in `src/stores/characterStore.ts`. React islands (e.g., `CharacterSelectGrid`) are mounted with `client:load` inside Astro pages.
- **Commands**: `npm run dev` (or `npm start`) to serve, `npm run build` for prod build, `npm run preview` to test build, `npm run check-env` to verify env wiring. Project uses ESM (`type: module`).
- **Assets & content**: Static player assets under `public/player/**`; quest/content configs under `src/content/**` and `src/content/config.ts`. Title logo is at `src/assets/img/logo.png`.
- **Server code (legacy)**: `src/mod/serverStorage.ts`, `src/mod/serverCrypto.ts`, and API routes under `src/pages/api/**` implement Mongo/Redis/JWT flows; treat as legacy while client-only mode is active. If you must touch them, keep Mongo optional and avoid breaking in-memory fallbacks.
- **Styling conventions**: Page-level styles are colocated in `.astro` files. Prefer CSS variables/gradients already in use; keep typography light and space-themed colors (#040712, blues/teals) consistent with title screen.
- **Testing/verification**: There is no dedicated test runner; sanity check by running `npm run dev` and loading `/` and `/character-select`. Ensure Web Crypto/IndexedDB usage is wrapped in try/catch for unsupported environments.
- **Deployment**: Vercel adapter present (`@astrojs/vercel`); avoid introducing Node-only APIs into client bundles. Keep imports SSR-safe—guard `window`/`indexedDB` access inside browser-only code.
